description.narrative: Grupo Farinter Internacional S.R.L. (Farinter or the Group) is a family-owned, private company headquartered in Honduras engaged in the distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and consumer products. Farinter has presence across the region with distribution centers and pharmacy stores in Honduras, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, and Panama. IFC proposes to provide a long-term loan to finance its strategic plan which includes (i) the acquisition of companies in the pharmaceutical sector in Central America; and (ii) the construction of two new distribution centers in Honduras and Nicaragua. The IFC loan will be disbursed to Farinters subsidiaries in Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, and Costa Rica (jointly the Co-Borrowers).

The most significant expected project-level outcome is an increase in access to quality and affordable pharmaceutical products in Central American countries through the semi-automation of distribution services and continued production of licensed products. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that this investment will promote competitiveness in these countries pharmaceutical distribution markets, by scaling output through an important distributor and introducing more pharmaceutical products in these markets. IFC will monitor the following indicators: (i) total number of members of the board of directors; (ii) number of female members of the board of directors; (iii) total number of senior management positions; (iv) number of females in senior management positions; (v) total direct employment in operations and maintenance; and (vi) female direct employment in operations and maintenance.
